items.html:
Seth Rance is an allrounder who has shown a fair amount of promise in 2009-10, his first full season with Central Districts. His fast-medium bowling was especially effective in the HRV Cup, the domestic Twenty20 tournament which Central Districts won: in six games Rance took 11 wickets at an economy rate of 6.37, the best among all bowlers in the team. He didn't get too many opportunities with the bat in that competition, but two first-class fifties - and a strike rate of more than 90 - in eight innings in the season suggests a fair amount of talent in that department as well.
